Title: Sr. Data Engineer
Description: Job Description Why GMF? GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences, and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. Responsibilities About the role Data Engineer III designs, develops, tests, deploys, and maintains highly scalable data management and integration solutions. The role is responsible for designing and developing complex, production-grade data pipelines, transforming data from diverse enterprise sources into reliable and consumable data products, and ensuring data quality, performance, security, scalability, and operational reliability. This role requires advanced hands-on experience with Databricks and modern cloud data engineering technologies, with the ability to independently design, implement, optimize, and support complex data engineering solutions. Strong experience with cloud services and architecture, particularly Microsoft Azure, is highly desirable. About The Initiative This role will be part of a strategic, multi-year transformation focused on modernizing GM Financial’s servicing platform and shaping the future of how we serve our customers. The initiative brings together business, technology, data and customer experience teams to deliver simpler, more scalable and innovative capabilities, leveraging product and service design, automation and AI. Team members will have the opportunity to contribute to a high-impact transformation, collaborate across functions and markets, and help build capabilities that create lasting value for our customers and the business. In This Role You Will Design, develop, test, deploy, optimize, and support complex, scalable, and production-grade data pipelines using Databricks and related data engineering technologies. Develop robust ETL/ELT solutions to ingest, transform, integrate, and deliver data across cloud and enterprise environments. Design reusable and maintainable data integration patterns leveraging Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, APIs, and other appropriate technologies. Design and maintain efficient data models, data structures, and storage solutions. Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and error-handling processes to ensure reliable and accurate data delivery. Optimize Databricks and Spark workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with architects, application teams, data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate complex data requirements into scalable technical solutions. Integrate data from diverse enterprise sources using batch, API, streaming/event-driven, and other appropriate integration patterns. Establish and maintain appropriate data security, access control, and governance practices. Apply software and data engineering best practices, including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and production support. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex data integration, performance, and production issues. Document data processes, data flows, integration patterns, technical designs, pipeline architectures, and operational procedures. Perform other duties as assigned. Conform with all company policies and procedures. Qualifications What makes you an ideal candidate? Advanced hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, and SQL. Strong experience designing, developing, optimizing, and supporting complex, production-grade data pipelines using Databricks. Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT architecture, distributed data processing, data integration, and pipeline orchestration. Strong understanding of cloud-based data architectures and services, with Microsoft Azure experience strongly preferred. Experience with cloud data storage, integration, security, monitoring, identity/access management, and deployment capabilities. Experience ingesting and processing data from multiple formats and sources, including XML, JSON, Parquet, APIs, relational databases, cloud data stores, and messaging/event platforms. Strong experience with API-based integrations and enterprise application integrations. Knowledge of data modeling, data quality, reconciliation, metadata management, security, and data governance concepts. Experience with performance tuning and troubleshooting of large-scale distributed data workloads. Knowledge of source control, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern DevOps/DataOps practices. Working knowledge of Agile development, Scrum, and Application Lifecycle Management. Experience with Microsoft Azure technologies such as Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2), Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps is preferred. Experience with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and Unity Catalog is preferred. Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies is preferred. Experience integrating Oracle and other enterprise relational databases is preferred. Knowledge of IBM InfoSphere DataStage and Unix scripting is preferred. Experience modernizing legacy data integration platforms and workloads into modern cloud-based data architectures is preferred. Skills Databricks Apache Spark / PySpark Python Programming SQL Delta Lake Complex Data Pipeline Design and Development ETL / ELT and Data Integration Cloud Data Engineering Microsoft Azure Data Modeling API Integration Big Data and Distributed Processing Technologies Data Quality and Reconciliation Data Security and Governance Performance Optimization CI/CD and DevOps/DataOps Monitoring and Production Support Technical Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis Additional Knowledge And Skills Working effectively within an AI enabled environment: Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection Experience & Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience required. 4-6 years of experience in data engineering or a related field, including experience designing and developing complex, production-grade data pipelines and integration solutions, required. Demonstrated advanced hands-on experience with Databricks, including the design, development, optimization, and operational support of complex data pipelines, required. Demonstrated experience with Apache Spark/PySpark, Python, SQL, and large-scale distributed data processing required. Experience with modern cloud-based data platforms and architectures required. Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and cloud data architectures is strongly preferred. Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise systems, APIs, relational databases, cloud storage platforms, and messaging/event platforms preferred. Title: Principal AI Solutions Lead
Description: Who are we? Auction Technology Group (ATG) is transforming the multi-billion-dollar global auction industry. Our platforms connect thousands of auction houses with buyers in over 170 countries, powering more than $15 billion in annual sales. Through innovative online auction technologies, we help auctioneers expand their reach, boost efficiency, and maximize value—while giving bidders unrivaled access to rare and specialized items. As a publicly traded company, ATG has scaled from $18 million to $170 million in revenue, with sustained growth beyond the pandemic. We're modernizing one of the last industries to fully go digital—building a global, category-defining business in the process. Who are we looking for? As our Applied AI Lead, you’ll be the person who makes AI real at ATG — not as a strategy deck, but as working tools people use every day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you’ll build alongside the team, and you’ll set the standards, governance, and direction for how the organization builds and adopts AI. Roughly half your time is hands-on delivery. You’ll size opportunities, design future-state flows, document requirements, build solutions using AI-assisted development tools, and deploy them across Operations, Finance, and HR. This matters to us: you can’t set credible standards for AI-built systems if you aren’t living under them yourself. The other half is scope only you will carry. You’ll define how these systems are governed — who can build what, how tools are reviewed, who owns them after launch, and how we retire what no longer earns its place. You’ll partner with Legal and IT on the security and data-privacy questions that AI-built tools raise. You’ll lead adoption across the organization, including running internal build events that get colleagues outside this team creating their own solutions. And you’ll own the implementation of major AI platforms, most immediately our AI-powered customer support system: a significant cross-functional program spanning integration, change management, and rollout. This role delivers against ATG’s Hands-Off Keyboard (HOK) mandate: our commitment to taking manual work out of the business. You won’t have direct reports, but you will set the bar for how ATG builds with AI, and you’ll mentor the Automation Associate on this team. Key Responsibilities Hands-On Delivery Build and deploy automations yourself. You’ll size opportunities, design the future-state flow, document requirements, and ship working solutions using AI-assisted development tools — keeping a steady cadence of delivered projects alongside the program work below. Maintenance & Support Keep the portfolio running. You’ll carry your share of the support load for deployed tools and set how the team handles it. You’ll also make the call on when a tool should be rebuilt, absorbed into a core system, or retired. AI Support Platform Implementation Own the end-to-end implementation of ATG’s AI-powered customer support system: integration planning, cross-functional coordination, change management, and rollout across our marketplace brands. This is a major program and one of the single largest opportunities in front of us. Governance & Standards Define how AI-built systems are governed at ATG including what gets built and by whom, how tools are reviewed and documented, who owns them after launch, and how they’re maintained or retired. Legal, IT & Security Partnership Work with Legal and IT on how AI tools handle company and customer data, what’s permitted, and what safeguards are required. You’ll translate between the technical reality and the risk questions leadership needs answered. Organizational Enablement Lead AI adoption beyond this team across all ATG employees. Provide training, internal hackathons and build events, office hours, and practical support that turns curious colleagues into capable builders. Measurement & Reporting Own the portfolio view of what we’re delivering: usage, adoption, and savings realized against savings projected. Report it credibly to senior leadership, including where projects underperform and what we’re doing about it. Key Requirements Who are you? You’ve built and shipped internal tools or automations that provide value and that people use today. You’ve led a significant cross-functional implementation or platform rollout end to end: stakeholder alignment, change management, go-live. Fluent with AI-assisted development and low-code tools, and current on how fast the space is moving. Pragmatic about what these tools do well and clear-eyed about where they don’t belong. You’ve handled governance, security, or data-privacy questions inside a real organization, and you can hold a productive conversation with Legal and IT rather than an adversarial one. Strong commercial instincts: you can size a prize, defend an estimate, and tell leadership when something isn’t worth doing. Credible with senior stakeholders and comfortable influencing without authority. You’ll lead a lot of people who don’t report to you. An appetite for teaching and raising other people’s capability. A meaningful part of this job is making colleagues better at building. Bonus: experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, or a multi-brand operating environment; exposure to customer support platforms or contact center technology.

Licenciatura concluida Ingeniería, Economía, Finanzas, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines . Al menos dos años de experiencia previa en Banca, Fintech, o Afin Sólida capacidad analítica y gusto por las matemáticas. Conocimientos de bases de datos. Inglés intermedio. Interés por el análisis financiero, riesgo, crédito y toma de decisiones basada en datos. Curiosidad y capacidad para aprender rápidamente. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Prestaciones de ley y superiores. Días personales (PTO). Horario de lunes a viernes. Beneficios adicionales. Un entorno de aprendizaje y crecimiento acelerado. Exposición a proyectos y decisiones que impactan directamente el negocio. Title: Automation & AI Analyst
Description: About PayJoy PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth. This role We're hiring an Automation & AI Analyst to build and own the connective tissue between our platforms: integrating our CRM (Zoho) with the tools around it, onboarding new SaaS systems, and designing end-to-end automations that move and transform data from our data warehouse into downstream SaaS systems. You'll build these flows to be trustworthy by design and resilient, using logs to catch failures and improve. This is a hands-on role for someone self-driven, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to turn needs into working automation, and excited to bring an AI-first point of view to how we solve problems. Responsibilities Integrate platforms & onboard tools - Build and maintain connections between the Zoho CRM and the tools around it, and evaluate and onboard new SaaS platforms (e.g., Spiff) into our ecosystem Design automations end to end - Build data and process automations from scratch that move and transform data from Databricks into downstream systems (e.g., Kyriba), owning them from design through production Build in quality & human-in-the-loop controls - Embed intermediate data-quality checks and alerting into every flow, and implement approval gates where results are reviewed and signed off by a human on a dashboard before being committed Make flows self-healing & observable - Work with logs to detect errors, retry transient failures automatically, and route anything unresolved into a review flow - so issues surface and resolve without silent data loss Partner with stakeholders & drive improvements — Translate stakeholder needs into working automation, operate independently without needing to be unblocked, and proactively bring AI-driven approaches to how problems get solved Qualifications Python - strong scripting and automation, including consuming and building REST API integrations (authentication/tokens, pagination, rate limits), and parsing and reshaping JSON into target schemas API & systems integration - comfortable wiring systems together and matching data to a destination's required format; thoughtful about failure handling, retries, and not passing bad data downstream Databricks - building and running data/automation pipelines (Spark / SQL) AI / LLMs - practical use of AI tools to build and accelerate automation, and a point of view on where AI can add value Observability - working with logs and monitoring to diagnose and recover from errors Self-driven - makes progress autonomously and unblocks themselves rather than waiting to be unblocked Methodical problem-solver - reads errors, reasons through them, and debugs calmly under pressure Desirable (a plus) hands-on experience with Zoho (CRM and its APIs), Infrastructure know-how (containers/Docker, AWS),  Experience onboarding or integrating SaaS platforms, Benefits Benefits may vary by country 100% Company Funded : Private Health Insurance for employee and immediate family 20 days vacation, unlimited sick leave $2,000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk $2,000 USD annual Professional Development perk Phone Finance, headphone benefit, home office equipment allowance and wellness perks PayJoy is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. PayJoy Principles Finance for the next billion * Ownership * Break Through Walls * Live Communication * Transparency & Directness * Focus on Scale * Work-Life Balance * Embrace Diversity * Speed * Active Listening We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Associate Consultant - Chemicals Consulting
Description: About The Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 08 Associate Consultant - Chemicals Consulting About The Role: As an Associate Consultant in Chemicals Consulting, you will support project teams in solving commercial, strategic, and investment questions for clients across the global chemicals value chain. You will gather and test evidence, build structured analyses and models, and turn findings into clear, accurate, client-ready outputs. This is a development role with exposure to experienced consultants, S&P Global Energy data and experts, international clients, and a broad range of commodity and specialty chemical markets. The Team The Chemicals Consulting team is part of S&P Global Energy and combines market intelligence, proprietary data, industry expertise, and consulting methods to help clients make high-value decisions across the chemicals value chain. Responsibilities And Impact Conduct structured research: Perform secondary and primary research on chemical markets, companies, assets, technologies, end-use sectors, trade, policy, and sustainability, using S&P Global Energy resources and credible external sources with clear documentation of assumptions and references. Build and maintain consulting analyses: Develop market sizing, supply-demand balances, competitor and asset benchmarking, price and margin analysis, production cost comparisons, value-chain maps, scenario models, and basic financial or feasibility assessments under project-team guidance. Synthesize evidence: Translate quantitative and qualitative evidence into concise charts, tables, written findings, and presentation pages; check calculations, units, definitions, and source consistency so that outputs are accurate, traceable, and client-ready. Support client engagements: Assist in interviews, client meetings, and workshops by preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and following through on assigned analyses; communicate progress, issues, and emerging insights clearly to the project manager. Required Qualifications: What We're Looking For: An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 1+ years of relevant experience in chemical markets, energy, industrial markets, consulting, market intelligence, or financial analysis. Analytical Skills: Strong numerical and analytical skills, including confidence working with market and company data, checking calculations, and drawing evidence-based conclusions; proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint is required. Communication & Learning Agility: Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to organize information logically and produce accurate, professional work; willingness to learn chemical value chains, market fundamentals, and consulting methods. Consulting And Power Skills: Curiosity and Structured Problem Solving: Asks good questions, breaks work into manageable steps, and distinguishes evidence from assumption. Quality and Ownership: Delivers reliable work, checks details, raises issues early, and follows tasks through to completion. Communication and Teamwork: Explains analysis clearly, listens to feedback, and works effectively with colleagues across disciplines, seniority levels, and locations. Adaptability: Manages changing priorities, learns new markets and analytical techniques quickly, and applies feedback to improve performance. Additional Preferred Qualifications. Specialized Knowledge: Exposure to petrochemicals, polymers, fertilizers, specialty chemicals, refining, process technology, sustainability, circularity, or industrial decarbonization. Technical & Digital Tools: Experience with data analysis or visualization tools, financial modeling, market databases, statistics, Python, Power BI, or similar analytical applications. Global Perspective: Additional language capability and prior experience working or studying in an international or client-facing environment. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration. Description: The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle{{{{~}}}} With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role{{{{~}}}} We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do{{{{~}}}} Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For{{{{~}}}} Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}} Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With{{{{~}}}} Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process{{{{~}}}} Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious.
